comment: Run 10 dots rise steadily from about v1917 (u1990) to v1908 (u2142) and then stay level to the end (dot tops v1904 to v1905 from u2142 to u2317), so there is no local maximum at the mark. At u2107 the solid run 4 line (ink about v1896 to v1908) crosses the dot row; the mark at v1906 sits on run 4's ink, about 4 px above where the merged run 10 dot center would be (about v1910). Reading of the band: the upper stroke (v1899 to 1909, u1960 to 2075) is run 12 and the lower U (min about v1930) is run 4, because run 4's rising branch extrapolates into the U and the run 4 hook in Fig 4-20 bottoms near 21 lb.

Off: (1890,1911) sits on a run 10 dot (ink u1883 to 1894, v1905 to 1915, in the dot rhythm u1842, 1857, 1873, 1888) inside run 12's dash gap: the short dash ends at u1870 (v1913 to 1924) and v1911 to 1920 is white at u1891 to 1899, so the next run 12 dash starts under run 4 at u1895 or later. On: (1949,1908) is on the run 12 long dash (ink v1904 to 1915 at u1948), beside the vertical grid line.

(2012,1904) and (2071,1903) are on the upper stroke of the merged band (ink v1899 to 1909 at u2012; v1901 to 1904 at u2066 to 2070), which is run 12's long dash ending near the grid line at u2072 to 2076 (run 4 is the lower U). (2135,1916) is on the run 12 short dash fragment (ink v1913 to 1918 at u2131 to 2136) between that long dash and the next one starting at u2155; this fits run 12's rhythm (long about 180 px, gap 20, short 40, gap 20). Depends on the band reading given in item 001.

The mark is on run 4, but the bend is where the line crosses the 50 lb grid line: du/dv about 0.44 above v1845, about 0.8 below v1866, 1.0 by v1885. Tangent lines meet at about (1864,1865) and the line's corner is about (1867,1865), some 13 px up-line from the mark (beyond 8 px). The next bend, into the minimum, is near (1907,1908).

Near the origin the bundle is run 4's solid stroke on the right (straight lower-right edge, about 14 px wide, u757 to 770 at v3259) plus run 10's dots on the left (notches in the left edge about every 13 px at v3204, 3217, 3230, 3244). (752,3259) lies in that left strand, 2 px right of the frame edge (u750) and 4 px left of run 4's ink. Below v3253 the strand merges with the frame, so single dots cannot be resolved; the dot rhythm would put a gap near v3258, hence low confidence.
(1695,2782) is inside the last run 10 dot (ink u1687 to 1696, v2776 to 2787), 1 px from its right edge. The next ink to the right is a grid line stub starting at u1706.

Q (751,3236) is at the left frame on the bundle's left strand, which carries run 10's dots, 32 px above the foot of the bundle; it is not run 12's start. P (857,3134) is the lower-left end of a 180 px long dash, but below it a smooth 40 px stroke beside run 4 (u816 to 843, v3145 to 3178, rounded end at (819,3177)), with about 20 px gaps above and below (the white gap to P's dash end, and the one-stroke waist at v3179 to 3192), fits run 12's dash rhythm, so the drawn line continues inside the bundle to the origin. First point at the foot of the bundle, about (758,3268). If that strand is not accepted as run 12, P would be the first separately drawn point.

The mark is on run 12's ink (the rounded lower-left end of the long dash), but no bend has its corner there. The steep part (short dash below, du/dv about -0.74) and the long dash (dv/du about -0.6 at its start) meet in the dash gap at about (843,3141), 20 to 25 px from the mark; along the long dash the slope eases smoothly (about 0.6, 0.46, 0.3) with no corner at (864,3131). If run 12 is instead taken to start at P's point, the mark is at the line's start, not a knee.

Off: (751,3236), (759,3228), (772,3214), (784,3203) lie on the bundle's left strand (run 10 dots, frame side), 15 to 28 px left of any path run 12 can take to the origin; (796,3192) is on run 4 in the one-stroke waist where run 12 has a dash gap; (808,3171) is on run 4 (ink u801 to 810, separated by a white slit at u810 to 813 from the run 12 short dash); (820,3158) is on run 4's side of the merged band, about 3 px from the short dash's inferred left edge (marginal). On: (832,3147) at the left edge of the run 12 short dash's top end (marginal), (843,3145) on that top end, (857,3134) on the lower-left end of the long dash. Positions of the last two subject samples were read from the crop because items.csv truncates the list.

Run 4 is the solid stroke on the right of the bundle (lower-right edge u765 to 770 at v3258 to 3266, about 14 px wide). (760,3266) is inside it. (758,3270) is at the ragged top of the bottom frame (v3269 to 3271), within 2 px of the stroke's last ink at v3268, so it counts under convention 2.

The mark is on a run 10 dot (center about (2089,2576)), but the bend is earlier: the dots run straight up at u2064 (v2609, v2594), then turn through (2072,2582) onto a nearly level course. The direction changes about 35 and 33 degrees at the dots (2064,2594) and (2072,2582); corner at about (2068,2587), 16 to 22 px from the mark. At the mark the direction changes only about 7 degrees.

Near the corner the three lines share one stroke on top of the bottom frame (ink v3789 to 3796 at u2228 to 2282). Runs 4 and 10 run just above run 12's dashes (v3781 to 3788, visible over the dash gaps at u2092 to 2110 and 2152 to 2169) and merge into this stroke near u2226 to 2262. (2270,3797) is at the stroke's lower edge, within 1 to 2 px of its ink at about the frame's top edge, 12 px from the right frame, so it is on the shared start. Line style cannot separate the three lines there.

On run 12 at the lower-left end of a dash (ink v3499 to 3510 at u600, merged with the horizontal grid line). The dash before the gap (u544 to 576) slopes about -0.44 (24 degrees), the dash after (u620 to 660) about -0.27 (15 degrees): a visible change of direction concentrated across the gap at the grid crossing. The tangent lines meet at about (600,3503), 4.5 px from the mark.

Run 12 is the dashed stroke lying on top of the bottom frame (its dash gaps at u2092 to 2110 and 2152 to 2169 show the frame's top at v3798; at u1930 to 1945 the stroke is v3786 to 3797 with the frame from v3799). (2277,3797) and (2134,3797) are on the dashes' bottom rows; (1979,3798) is between the dash's lower edge (about v3797) and the frame top (v3799), within 1 to 2 px.

Same situation as item 012. Run 4's own stroke reaches the run 12 stroke at about u2226 to 2262 and the three lines then share one stroke (v3789 to 3796) into the corner. (2274,3797) is at that stroke's lower edge, within 1 to 2 px of its ink, 8 px from the right frame. Line style cannot separate the lines there.
